title: Erdős #268: Path-Connectedness of Harmonic Subseries Points

problemStatement.formal: theorem harmonicPointSet_path_connected (d : ℕ) : IsPathConnected (harmonicPointSet d) := by sorry
problemStatement.plain: Erdos268Problem.lean has 1 remaining sorry: proving that the set X_d of harmonic subseries points is path-connected. The d=0 case is trivial (subsingleton), the d=1 case requires showing X_1 = (0,∞) via greedy construction, and d≥2 requires deeper analysis from Kovač-Tao 2024.
whyMatters: Geometric picture: X_d has nonempty interior (Kovač-Tao) AND is path-connected
d=1 case is concretely tractable with Mathlib's interval topology tools

proven: harmonicPointSet_nonempty: X_d is non-empty for all d
harmonicPointSet_dense_somewhere: X_d has nonempty interior (uses axiom)
contains_open_ball: X_d contains an open ball
open: harmonicPointSet_path_connected for d≥2 requires Kovač-Tao structural analysis
knownResults.goal: Prove IsPathConnected (harmonicPointSet d), at minimum for d=0 and d=1

currentState.nextAction: ORIENT: Search Mathlib for isPathConnected_Ioi, isPathConnected_singleton, Fin.isEmpty for d=0.
